answer: When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 4 times its size, so a group of 49 keys loses far more than 49 single identities would. The canyon graph is rebuilt each epoch, as a result the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the haven audit merges it again. Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the shale checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
